senses.title: Freedom from difficulty
senses.definition: the quality of being easy to do, so that little effort is needed
senses.definitionCN: 做起来容易、不需要多少力气的性质
senses.example: She lifted the crate with ease.
senses.exampleCN: 她轻松地就把木箱提了起来。
senses.why: The word came from comfort and opportunity; something within reach is something done without strain, and that became ease.
senses.whyCN: 这个词本指舒适与便利：在掌握之内的事做起来不费劲，这种不费劲就成了 ease。

senses.title: Comfort and freedom from strain
senses.titleCN: 舒适：身体或心情不受紧张
senses.definition: a state of bodily or mental comfort, without pain, worry or tension
senses.definitionCN: 身体或心理舒适，没有疼痛、忧虑或紧张的状态
senses.example: The warm bath put him at ease after the long drive.
senses.exampleCN: 长途驾驶后，热水澡让他放松下来。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense: a body settled into a fitting place, with nothing pressing against it.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的义项：身体安顿在合适的位置里，没有任何东西压着它。

senses.title: To relieve pain
senses.definition: to make pain, discomfort or a bad feeling less severe
senses.definitionCN: 使疼痛、不适或糟糕的感觉变得不那么严重
senses.example: The ointment eased the burn within minutes.
senses.exampleCN: 药膏几分钟内就缓解了灼痛。
senses.why: Comfort as a state becomes an action: you remove the pressure that kept the body from settling.
senses.whyCN: 当「舒适」作为一种状态转为动作：你移开了那个让身体无法安顿的压力。

senses.title: To loosen or relax
senses.definition: to make something less tight, less tense or less firmly fixed
senses.definitionCN: 使某物不那么紧、不那么绷、不那么牢固
senses.example: Ease the belt after the meal.
senses.exampleCN: 饭后把腰带松一松。
senses.why: A tight thing is under strain, and easing it restores the slack that comfort requires.
senses.whyCN: 紧的东西处在张力之下，ease 就是把它恢复成舒适所需要的松弛。

senses.title: To move something gently
senses.titleCN: 轻缓地移动：慢慢把某物移开或打开
senses.definition: to move someone or something slowly and carefully into or out of a place
senses.definitionCN: 把某人或某物缓慢小心地移进或移出某个位置
senses.example: She eased the drawer open without a sound.
senses.exampleCN: 她无声地把抽屉缓缓拉开。
senses.why: Careful movement avoids strain, so the verb that removes strain also describes motion done without a jolt.
senses.whyCN: 小心的移动能避开张力，于是表示「去除张力」的动词也用来描述不带顿挫的动作。

intro.en: Ease came into English from Old French, and its deeper origin has been debated rather than settled.
intro.cn: ease 经由古法语进入英语，其更早来源一直有争论而无定论。

items.en: Aise meant comfort, convenience and room to act, and it is the direct source of the English noun.
items.cn: aise 意为舒适、便利、有余地，是英语名词的直接来源。

items.en: One common explanation links aise to Latin adiacens, 'lying near'; other sources propose different origins, so the question is uncertain.
items.cn: 一种常见解释把 aise 联系到拉丁语 adiacens「邻近的」；也有资料提出别的来源，因此此事尚无定论。

items.en: The noun ease entered English and quickly added the senses of comfort and freedom from difficulty.
items.cn: 名词 ease 进入英语后，很快加上了「舒适」与「不费力」两义。

items.en: The verb developed from the noun, first as relieve and loosen, then as move gently.
items.cn: 动词由名词发展而来，先有「缓解、放松」，再引申为「轻缓移动」。

items.en: With ease, at ease and ease off fixed the word in everyday speech, while technical uses appeared in mechanics.
items.cn: with ease、at ease、ease off 把词固定在日常语言中，机械领域也出现了技术用法。

note.cn: 形近组收只差一个音的小词；近义组收表示舒适与缓解的词。

normalIntro.en: These hooks move from a body at rest to the hand that loosens a belt and opens a drawer without noise.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子从休息中的身体，走到那只松开腰带、无声拉开抽屉的手。

normal.en: Ease begins as a body that fits its place, then becomes a task that fits your strength.
normal.cn: ease 起初是身体适合所处的空间，后来成了任务适合你的力气。

normal.en: With ease turns the noun into an adverb: no strain visible on the face.
normal.cn: with ease 把名词变成副词：脸上看不出一点吃力。

normal.en: To ease pain is to take away what was pressing on the body.
normal.cn: ease pain 就是把压在身体上的东西移开。

normal.en: A belt, a knot and a screw are all eased by giving them back a little slack.
normal.cn: 腰带、绳结与螺丝，都是靠还回一点松弛来 ease 的。

normal.en: Ease a drawer open means moving it so gently that it never jolts.
normal.cn: ease a drawer open 指把抽屉移得极轻，轻到从不顿一下。

abstract.en: Picture a hand on a tight knot, slowly letting one loop go loose.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手按在紧结上，慢慢让一个环松开。

abstract.en: The same loosening can happen in a shoulder, a rule, a market or a drawer.
abstract.cn: 同一种「松开」可以发生在肩膀、规则、市场或抽屉上。

abstract.en: Ease means the pressure is reduced until motion becomes quiet.
abstract.cn: ease 意味着压力被减到动作变得安静为止。

examples.en: She lifted the crate with ease.
examples.cn: 她轻松地就把木箱提了起来。

examples.cn: 长途驾驶后，热水澡让他放松下来。

root: ease 经由古法语 aise「舒适、便利」进入英语；其更早来源有拉丁语 adiacens「邻近」等多种解释，尚无定论。

sensesIntro.en: Five senses of ease all reduce strain: no difficulty, bodily comfort, less pain, a looser fit, and a motion made quiet.
sensesIntro.cn: ease 的五个义项都在减少张力：不费力、身体舒适、疼痛减轻、配合变松，以及变得安静的动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand slowly loosens one loop of a tight knot.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手慢慢松开紧结上的一个环。

branches.en: THE TASK: what fits your strength is done without strain.
branches.cn: 任务线：适合你力气的事，做起来就不费劲。

branches.en: THE BODY: comfort is the original sense, a body settled with nothing pressing it.
branches.cn: 身体线：舒适是最初的义项，身体安顿下来，没有东西压着。

branches.en: THE RELIEF: the state becomes an action that removes pain.
branches.cn: 缓解线：状态转为动作，把疼痛移走。

branches.en: THE SLACK: a tight thing is given room again.
branches.cn: 松弛线：紧的东西重新获得余地。

branches.en: THE QUIET MOTION: strain-free movement is movement without a jolt.
branches.cn: 静动线：没有张力的移动，就是不带顿挫的移动。

intro.en: Ease is a French borrowing; English expands it with suffixes and a negative prefix rather than Latin roots.
intro.cn: ease 是法语借词，英语用后缀与否定前缀来扩展它，而不是拉丁词根。

latinIntro.en: A Latin link to adiacens has been proposed but not established, so it is presented as one explanation among several.
latinIntro.cn: 有人提出与拉丁语 adiacens 的联系，但并未确立，因此只作为若干解释之一。

senses.title: Without difficulty
senses.definition: in a way that needs little effort or skill
senses.definitionCN: 以不需要多少力气或技巧的方式
senses.example: The puzzle was easily solved by the youngest student.
senses.exampleCN: 最年轻的学生轻松解开了这个谜题。
senses.why: Easily is easy turned into an adverb: the adjective names the absence of difficulty, and -ly says that an action is performed in that way.
senses.whyCN: easily 是 easy 变成副词：形容词说出「没有困难」，-ly 表示动作正是以这种方式完成。

senses.title: Without strain or discomfort
senses.titleCN: 轻松地：不带紧张或不适
senses.definition: in a relaxed way, with no physical or mental strain
senses.definitionCN: 以放松的方式，没有身体或心理上的紧张
senses.example: After the medicine, he was breathing easily again.
senses.exampleCN: 服药之后，他又能顺畅呼吸了。
senses.why: The oldest sense of ease is bodily comfort, so easily can describe an action that leaves the body untroubled.
senses.whyCN: ease 最古老的义项是身体舒适，所以 easily 可以描述一种让身体不受困扰的动作。

senses.title: By a wide margin or beyond doubt
senses.definition: used before a comparison to mean by a large amount, or with little doubt
senses.definitionCN: 用于比较前，表示差距很大或几乎没有疑问
senses.example: She is easily the best player on the team.
senses.exampleCN: 她无疑是队里最好的球员。
senses.why: If no effort is needed to see it, the conclusion is not close; easily came to mark a judgement made without struggle.
senses.whyCN: 如果看出这一点毫不费力，结论就不接近势均力敌；easily 因此用来标记一个不需挣扎就能作出的判断。

intro.en: Easily is a regular English adverb built on easy, which itself came from French.
intro.cn: easily 是由 easy 加普通副词词尾构成的英语副词，而 easy 本身来自法语。

items.en: Aisie, the past participle of aisier 'to ease', described something that had been made comfortable or convenient.
items.cn: aisie 是动词 aisier「使舒适、使便利」的过去分词，形容已被弄得舒适或方便的事物。

items.en: English borrowed the word as easy and kept the senses of comfort and freedom from difficulty.
items.cn: 英语把这个词借为 easy，保留了「舒适」与「不费力」两义。

items.en: The native adverb ending -ly was added to the borrowed adjective, giving easily.
items.cn: 本族副词词尾 -ly 加在借来的形容词上，构成了 easily。

items.en: The adverb spread into comparisons, where easily the best became a fixed intensifying pattern.
items.cn: 这个副词扩展到比较结构，easily the best 成了固定的强调格式。

items.en: Easily now covers manner, comfort and certainty, all inherited from the single idea of no strain.
items.cn: 现代 easily 覆盖方式、舒适与确定三义，全都继承自「没有张力」这一个想法。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the family built on ease; the near-meaning group gathers adverbs for doing something without effort.
note.cn: 形近组收以 ease 为核心的一族词；近义组收表示「不费力地做某事」的副词。

entries.definition: An adjective meaning not difficult or not causing strain.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「容易的、不费力的」。

entries.definition: A noun and verb for comfort, relief or gentle movement.
entries.definitionCN: 名词兼动词，表示舒适、缓解或轻缓移动。

entries.definition: The noun for the quality of being easy.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，指「容易、轻松」的性质。

entries.definition: In a way that shows no effort at all.
entries.definitionCN: 以完全看不出费力的方式。

entries.definition: Quickly and willingly, without difficulty.
entries.definitionCN: 迅速而乐意地，没有困难。

normalIntro.en: These hooks turn the adjective easy into an adverb, then stretch it to comfort and certainty.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子把形容词 easy 变成副词，再把它拉到「舒适」与「确定」。

normal.en: Add -ly to easy and you describe how the job was done, not how the job was.
normal.cn: 给 easy 加 -ly，你描述的是事情怎样做成，而不是事情本身怎样。

normal.en: The pen moves easily when there is no strain in the hand.
normal.cn: 手上没有紧张时，笔就 easily 地走。

normal.en: Easily the best means the gap is wide enough to see without effort.
normal.cn: easily the best 意味着差距大到不费劲就能看出。

normal.en: Breathe easily is the body's version of a problem solved.
normal.cn: breathe easily 是身体版本的一句「问题解决了」。

normal.en: Easily and easy differ by one ending, not by one idea.
normal.cn: easily 与 easy 只差一个词尾，不差一个概念。

abstract.en: Picture a blade drawn through soft wood, leaving a clean shaving and no resistance.
abstract.cn: 想象刀刃划过软木，刨出一整条干净的薄片，毫无阻力。

abstract.en: The same no-resistance can describe a body breathing, a team winning or a truth being seen.
abstract.cn: 同一种「无阻力」可以形容身体呼吸、球队获胜，或一个真相被看见。

abstract.en: Easily means the path offered no obstacle worth mentioning.
abstract.cn: easily 意味着这条路没有值得一提的阻碍。

examples.en: The puzzle was easily solved by the youngest student.
examples.cn: 最年轻的学生轻松解开了这个谜题。

examples.en: After the medicine, he was breathing easily again.
examples.cn: 服药之后，他又能顺畅呼吸了。

examples.en: She is easily the best player on the team.
examples.cn: 她无疑是队里最好的球员。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses of easily: an action done without difficulty, a body free from strain, and a judgement that holds by a wide margin.
sensesIntro.cn: easily 的三个义项：不费力完成的动作、不受紧张困扰的身体，以及差距悬殊而成立的判断。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a blade passes through soft wood and leaves a clean shaving.
core.cn: 核心意象：刀刃穿过软木，留下一整条干净薄片。

branches.en: THE TASK: the work is done with little effort or skill required.
branches.cn: 任务线：完成这件事所需力气或技巧很少。

branches.en: THE BODY: the action leaves the body relaxed and untroubled.
branches.cn: 身体线：这个动作让身体放松、不受困扰。

branches.en: THE JUDGEMENT: the gap is so wide that seeing the result takes no effort.
branches.cn: 判断线：差距太大，看出结果毫不费力。

branches.en: THE OBVIOUS: what needs no effort to see is also what hardly anyone can dispute.
branches.cn: 显见线：不费劲就能看见的事，也几乎无人能争。

branches.en: THE OPEN PATH: in work and in the body, nothing blocks the motion.
branches.cn: 通畅线：无论做事还是身体，都没有东西阻挡动作。

intro.en: Easily is a transparent form: a borrowed adjective plus a native adverb ending.
intro.cn: easily 的构造一目了然：一个借来的形容词加一个本族副词词尾。

senses.title: The direction of sunrise
senses.definition: the direction in which the sun rises, one of the four main compass points
senses.definitionCN: 太阳升起的方向，罗盘上四个主方位之一
senses.example: The sun rises in the east and lights the harbour first.
senses.exampleCN: 太阳从东方升起，先照亮港口。
senses.why: The compass point is named for the dawn: a direction is defined by where the light first appears.
senses.whyCN: 这个罗盘方位是按黎明命名的：一个方向由光最先出现的地方来定义。

senses.title: The eastern part of a place
senses.definition: the part of a country, city or region that lies toward the east
senses.definitionCN: 国家、城市或地区中位于东侧的部分
senses.example: Most of the factories are in the east of the city.
senses.exampleCN: 大多数工厂位于城市东部。
senses.why: The same word is applied to a map: the east of a place is simply the half nearest the sunrise.
senses.whyCN: 同一个词被用到地图上：一个地方的东部，就是它离日出最近的那一半。

senses.title: The East as a region
senses.titleCN: 东方：作为文化与政治区域
senses.definition: the countries of Asia, especially when contrasted with the West as a cultural or political group
senses.definitionCN: 亚洲国家，尤指相对于「西方」这一文化与政治群体时
senses.example: Trade between the East and the West shaped the old port.
senses.exampleCN: 东方与西方之间的贸易塑造了这座老港。
senses.why: Capitalised, the direction becomes a cultural camp, so East names societies rather than a bearing.
senses.whyCN: 大写之后，这个方向成了文化阵营，于是 East 指社会群体而非方位读数。

intro.en: East is a native Germanic word whose oldest meaning is tied to dawn, not to a map.
intro.cn: east 是日耳曼语本族词，其最早含义与黎明相连，而不是与地图相连。

items.en: A root connected with dawn or shining is often reconstructed, but its exact form and development are uncertain.
items.cn: 常会重构一个与黎明、发亮有关的词根，但其确切形态与演变不确定。

items.en: A Germanic word for the east, literally the dawn side, is reconstructed and survives widely.
items.cn: 一般认为存在一个意为「东方」、字面即「黎明那一侧」的日耳曼语词，并在各语言中广泛留存。

items.en: Ēast named the direction and also appeared in compounds for eastern places and peoples.
items.cn: ēast 指这个方向，也出现在指东部地方与人群的复合词中。

items.en: The word kept its spelling and added the sense of the eastern part of a country.
items.cn: 这个词保留拼写，并加上了「一国东部」的意思。

items.en: Capitalised East became a cultural and political label, especially in East and West contrasts.
items.cn: 大写的 East 成了文化与政治标签，尤见于「东方与西方」的对比。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers compass and direction words; the near-meaning group gathers words for the eastern side or region.
note.cn: 形近组收罗盘与方向词；近义组收表示东侧或东方区域的词。

entries.definition: Comfort or freedom from difficulty, with no directional meaning.
entries.definitionCN: 舒适或不费力，与方向无关。

entries.definition: An adjective meaning in or from the east.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「东部的、来自东方的」。

entries.definition: The direction of sunset, opposite to east.
entries.definitionCN: 日落的方向，与 east 相对。

entries.definition: The East as a cultural region, especially in older or literary use.
entries.definitionCN: 作为文化区域的东方，多用于较早或文学性语境。

entries.definition: Toward the east, used of movement or direction.
entries.definitionCN: 朝东，用于移动或方向。

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin at sunrise and end with the East as a name for a whole region.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子从日出开始，到 East 成为一整片区域的名称结束。

normal.en: East is first a fact about light: the side where the day starts.
normal.cn: east 首先是关于光的事实：一天开始的那一侧。

normal.en: Point at the sunrise, then point at a map: the same word covers both.
normal.cn: 先指向日出，再指向地图：同一个词覆盖这两件事。

normal.en: The east of a city is simply the half nearer the sunrise.
normal.cn: 城市的东部，就是离日出更近的那一半。

normal.en: Capital East turns a compass point into a cultural camp.
normal.cn: 大写的 East 把一个罗盘方位变成了一个文化阵营。

normal.en: East and west are learned together, like left and right.
normal.cn: east 与 west 是一起学会的，就像左与右。

abstract.en: Picture a dark sea, then one bright line widening along the horizon.
abstract.cn: 想象一片暗海，然后地平线上一条亮线逐渐变宽。

abstract.en: The same bright line can mark a direction, a coastline, or a whole civilisation.
abstract.cn: 同一条亮线可以标出一个方向、一段海岸，或一整个文明。

abstract.en: East means where the light comes from, and everything later pinned to that side.
abstract.cn: east 意味着光来的那一侧，以及后来钉在这一侧的一切。

examples.en: The sun rises in the east and lights the harbour first.
examples.cn: 太阳从东方升起，先照亮港口。

examples.en: Most of the factories are in the east of the city.
examples.cn: 大多数工厂位于城市东部。

examples.en: Trade between the East and the West shaped the old port.
examples.cn: 东方与西方之间的贸易塑造了这座老港。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「伊斯特」——太阳从海面升起，渔村窗先亮

root: 古英语 ēast「东方」来自日耳曼语，字面与「黎明那一侧」相关；更早的印欧词根常被重构为与「破晓、发亮」有关，但形态不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses of east widen from a compass point to a country's eastern half, then to the East as a cultural region.
sensesIntro.cn: east 的三个义项从罗盘方位扩大到一国的东半，再到作为文化区域的东方。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a dark sea with one bright line widening along the horizon.
core.cn: 核心意象：暗海上，一条亮线沿地平线逐渐变宽。

chain: THE FAR SIDE OF A MAP

branches.en: THE COMPASS: the fixed direction of sunrise.
branches.cn: 罗盘线：日出所在的固定方向。

branches.en: THE REGION: the half of a place that lies toward sunrise.
branches.cn: 区域线：一个地方朝向日出的那一半。

branches.en: THE CULTURE: the East as a name for Asian societies set against the West.
branches.cn: 文化线：East 作为与西方相对的亚洲社会之名。

branches.en: THE SIDE: direction and local region both depend on where the light first arrives.
branches.cn: 侧线：方向与地方区域都取决于光最先到达哪里。

branches.en: THE LABEL: a compass point becomes a political camp once it is capitalised.
branches.cn: 标签线：一旦大写，罗盘方位就成了政治阵营。

intro.en: East is a native root; English builds the whole directional family with suffixes.
intro.cn: east 是本族词根，英语用后缀构成整个方向词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin has its own words for east, but they did not supply this English term.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语有自己的「东方」用词，但并未提供这个英语词。

items.example: It is the direct source of east.
items.exampleCN: 它是 east 的直接来源。

items.example: It forms the rare plural easts.

definition_zh: 东部的；东方的；向东的；从东面来的
definition_en: located in, coming from, or belonging to the east, or characteristic of the East as a cultural region
core_image: 地图右半侧的海岸线一路向北弯，晨光先落在那里
scene: 地图的右半侧，海岸线一路向北弯。The eastern coast is cooler and wetter than the west.
sceneCN: 这里 eastern 是「东部的」（第 1 个义项：位于东侧或属于东部）；句意为东部海岸比西部更凉、更湿。图中可辨识物件：地图、海岸线、向北的弯弧。

pos.zh: 形容词：东部的；东方的；向东的；从东面来的

forms.label: 比较级（形容词，多音节用 more）
最高级（形容词，多音节用 most）

derivatives.zh: 由本词加指人后缀构成，义为「东部人；东方人」
与 eastern 同源，义为「向东的；来自东方的」
由本词与最高级成分复合构成，义为「最东端的」

senses.title: Located in the east
senses.definition: situated in or belonging to the eastern part of a place
senses.definitionCN: 位于某地东侧或属于其东部的
senses.example: The eastern coast is cooler and wetter than the west.
senses.exampleCN: 东部海岸比西部更凉、更湿。
senses.why: Eastern is east plus an old adjective ending: it simply assigns something to the sunrise side.
senses.whyCN: eastern 是 east 加一个古老形容词词尾：它只是把某物归到日出那一侧。

senses.title: Belonging to the East
senses.titleCN: 东方的：属于东方文化区域
senses.definition: characteristic of the East as a cultural or political region, especially Asia
senses.definitionCN: 具有作为文化或政治区域的东方特征的，尤指亚洲
senses.example: The gallery has a fine collection of eastern ceramics.
senses.exampleCN: 这家美术馆藏有一批精美的东方陶瓷。
senses.why: Once East names a cultural camp, eastern becomes the adjective that stamps objects and people with it.
senses.whyCN: 当 East 指一个文化阵营，eastern 就成了给物品和人盖上这一印记的形容词。

senses.title: Coming from the east
senses.definition: of a wind or weather pattern, coming from the east
senses.definitionCN: 指风或天气形势从东面吹来
senses.example: An eastern wind brought cold air off the sea.
senses.exampleCN: 一股东风把海上的冷空气送了过来。
senses.why: A wind is named for where it starts, so an eastern wind is one that began at the sunrise side and arrived here.
senses.whyCN: 风是按它起于何处来命名的，所以 eastern wind 是从日出那一侧刮来、抵达此处的风。

intro.en: Eastern is a native English formation from east plus an old suffix, not a borrowed word.
intro.cn: eastern 是英语内部由 east 加古老后缀构成的本族形式，并非借词。

items.en: Easterne meant 'eastern' and already used a suffix meaning belonging to a direction.
items.cn: easterne 意为「东部的」，已经使用了表示「属于某方向」的后缀。

items.en: The ending weakened in pronunciation and the modern spelling eastern appeared.
items.cn: 词尾读音弱化，现代拼写 eastern 出现。

items.en: The word expanded from local geography to cultural descriptions of the East.
items.cn: 这个词从地方地理扩展到对东方的文化描述。

items.en: Eastern hemisphere, eastern Europe and eastern coast fixed the word in geography textbooks.
items.cn: eastern hemisphere、eastern Europe、eastern coast 把这个词固定在地理教材里。

items.en: The capitalised cultural use has become sensitive, so writers often specify the region instead.
items.cn: 大写形式的文化用法已变得敏感，因此作者常改为明确指出具体区域。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers directional adjectives and the base word; the near-meaning group gathers adjectives for the east or the Orient.
note.cn: 形近组收方向形容词与词基；近义组收表示东方或东方地域的形容词。

entries.definition: The direction of sunrise, or the eastern part of a place.
entries.definitionCN: 日出的方向，或某地的东部。

entries.definition: Located in or belonging to the west.
entries.definitionCN: 位于西侧或属于西部的。

entries.definition: Toward the east, or coming from the east.
entries.definitionCN: 朝东的，或来自东方的。

entries.definition: An older adjective for the East, now often avoided as dated or insensitive.
entries.definitionCN: 较早用来指东方的形容词，现常被视为过时或不妥而回避。

entries.definition: Directed or moving toward the east.
entries.definitionCN: 朝东的，或向东移动的。

normalIntro.en: These hooks attach the suffix to east, then move from a coastline to a culture and to a wind.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子把后缀挂到 east 上，再从海岸线走到文化，最后走到风。

normal.en: Eastern is east wearing an adjective coat: it tells you which side something belongs to.
normal.cn: eastern 是穿上形容词外衣的 east：它告诉你某物属于哪一侧。

normal.en: A coastline is eastern because the map puts it on the sunrise side.
normal.cn: 一段海岸被称作 eastern，是因为地图把它放在日出那一侧。

normal.en: Eastern ceramics means the objects carry a cultural label, not just a compass bearing.
normal.cn: eastern ceramics 意味着这些器物带着文化标签，而不只是一个罗盘方位。

normal.en: An eastern wind starts where the sun comes up and arrives here cold.
normal.cn: 东风从太阳升起的地方出发，到这里时已是冷的。

normal.en: Western is the mirror image, built the same way from the other side.
normal.cn: western 是镜像，用同样的方法从另一侧构成。

abstract.en: Picture a map held up to the morning light, its right edge glowing first.
abstract.cn: 想象一张地图举到晨光前，右边缘先亮起来。

abstract.en: The same glowing edge can be a coast, a hemisphere, a tradition, or a wind's starting point.
abstract.cn: 同一条发亮的边缘可以是海岸、半球、一种传统，或风的起点。

abstract.en: Eastern means everything assigned to the sunrise side of a line.
abstract.cn: eastern 意味着一切被分配到某条线日出侧的东西。

examples.en: The eastern coast is cooler and wetter than the west.
examples.cn: 东部海岸比西部更凉、更湿。

examples.en: The gallery has a fine collection of eastern ceramics.
examples.cn: 这家美术馆藏有一批精美的东方陶瓷。

examples.en: An eastern wind brought cold air off the sea.
examples.cn: 一股东风把海上的冷空气送了过来。

root: 古英语 ēasterne「东部的」由 ēast「东方」加表示方向归属的后缀构成；中古英语词尾弱化，形成现代 eastern。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses of eastern assign something to the east: a place, a cultural region, or the origin of a wind.
sensesIntro.cn: eastern 的三个义项都在把某物归到东方：一处地方、一个文化区域，或一阵风的来处。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a map is held to the morning light and its right edge glows first.
core.cn: 核心意象：地图举向晨光，右边缘先发亮。

branches.en: THE MAP: the position of a place on the sunrise side.
branches.cn: 地图线：一处地方位于日出侧的位置。

branches.en: THE CULTURE: objects and people stamped with the label of the East.
branches.cn: 文化线：被打上东方标签的物品与人。

branches.en: THE WIND: weather named for where it begins.
branches.cn: 风线：天气按它起于何处来命名。

branches.en: THE ASSIGNMENT: both geography and culture are ways of saying this belongs over there.
branches.cn: 归属线：地理与文化都是在说「这个属于那边」。

branches.en: THE ORIGIN: a coastline and a wind both sit at the sunrise edge of a map.
branches.cn: 来处线：海岸与风都位于地图的日出边缘。

intro.en: Eastern is east plus a native adjective suffix, and English adds further endings to the same stem.
intro.cn: eastern 是 east 加本族形容词后缀，英语还在同一词干上加更多词尾。

latinIntro.en: No Latin element is involved; the whole family is Germanic and English.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁语成分，整个词族属于日耳曼语与英语内部。

items.example: It marks plural use in fixed phrases.
items.exampleCN: 它标记固定短语中的复数用法。

definition_zh: 容易的；轻松的；舒适的；随和的；宽松的
definition_en: not difficult, not causing strain or worry, relaxed in manner, or not strict
core_image: 老人把椅子摆到树荫下，示意客人随便坐
scene: 老人把椅子摆到树荫下，示意客人随便坐。The instructions were easy to follow.
sceneCN: 这里 easy 是「容易的」（第 1 个义项：做起来不困难）；句意为这些说明很容易照着做。图中可辨识物件：树荫、椅子、说明纸。

pos.zh: 形容词：容易的；轻松的；舒适的；随和的；宽松的
副词：轻松地；慢慢地（多用于口语命令）

derivatives.zh: 由本词加副词后缀构成，义为「容易地；轻松地」
由本词加名词后缀构成，义为「容易；轻松」
由否定前缀与本词构成，义为「不安的；担心的」
由本词与 going 复合构成，义为「随和的；不慌不忙的」

senses.title: Not difficult
senses.definition: needing little effort, skill or thought to do or understand
senses.definitionCN: 做起来或理解起来所需力气、技巧或思考很少
senses.example: The instructions were easy to follow.
senses.exampleCN: 这些说明很容易照着做。
senses.why: The French source described something made convenient, and English kept that: a thing with no obstacle in the way is easy.
senses.whyCN: 法语来源形容被弄得便利的事物，英语保留了这个意思：没有障碍挡路的东西就是 easy。

senses.title: Comfortable and free from worry
senses.definition: comfortable, relaxed and free from pain, worry or pressure
senses.definitionCN: 舒适、放松，没有疼痛、忧虑或压力
senses.example: They spent an easy afternoon by the river.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在河边度过了一个轻松的下午。
senses.why: The oldest sense is comfort, so an easy life is one with nothing pressing against it.
senses.whyCN: 最早的义项是舒适，所以 an easy life 就是一种没有东西压着的生活。

senses.title: Relaxed or not strict
senses.definition: relaxed in manner or not strict in rules, so that people are treated gently
senses.definitionCN: 态度放松或规则不严，因而待人温和
senses.example: Our teacher is easy with deadlines if the work is honest.
senses.exampleCN: 只要作业是认真做的，我们老师对截止日期就很宽松。
senses.why: A person without strain is also a person who does not impose strain, and that is an easy teacher or an easy boss.
senses.whyCN: 没有紧张感的人也不会把紧张加给别人，这就是 an easy teacher 或 an easy boss。

senses.title: Easy to use or reach
senses.titleCN: 便捷的：易于使用或到达
senses.definition: in phrases such as easy access or easy to use, available without difficulty
senses.definitionCN: 用于 easy access、easy to use 等短语，表示不难获得或使用
senses.example: The new app is easy to use on a small phone.
senses.exampleCN: 这个新应用在小屏手机上很好用。
senses.why: This is sense one applied to tools and places: no obstacle stands between the person and the thing.
senses.whyCN: 这是第 1 个义项用在工具与场所上：人与物之间没有障碍。

intro.en: Easy entered English from French, and its deeper Latin link has long been debated.
intro.cn: easy 从法语进入英语，其更早的拉丁语联系长期有争论。

items.en: Aise meant comfort, convenience and room to act; it is the source of the whole English family.
items.cn: aise 意为舒适、便利、有余地，是整个英语词族的来源。

items.en: The past participle aisié described something made comfortable or convenient, and this form became English easy.
items.cn: 过去分词 aisié 形容被弄得舒适或便利的事物，这一形式成为英语 easy。

items.en: One explanation derives aise from Latin adiacens 'lying near', but other origins have been proposed and the matter is unsettled.
items.cn: 一种解释把 aise 追溯到拉丁语 adiacens「邻近的」，但另有其他来源说，此事尚无定论。

items.en: Easy covered both convenience and comfort, and the adverb easily soon followed.
items.cn: easy 兼指便利与舒适，副词 easily 很快随之出现。

items.en: Everyday phrases such as take it easy and easy money widened the word's social range.
items.cn: take it easy、easy money 等日常短语拓宽了这个词的社会使用范围。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the ease family and its opposites; the near-meaning group gathers adjectives for simple and comfortable things.
note.cn: 形近组收 ease 词族及其反义形式；近义组收表示「简单」与「舒适」的形容词。

entries.definition: A noun and verb for comfort, relief or gentle movement.
entries.definitionCN: 名词兼动词，表示舒适、缓解或轻缓移动。

entries.definition: The adverb meaning without difficulty or strain.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「容易地、轻松地」。

entries.definition: An adjective meaning worried or uncomfortable.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「不安的、担心的」。

entries.definition: Plain and not complicated, so that it is easy to understand.
entries.definitionCN: 朴素而不复杂，因而容易理解。

entries.definition: Physically relaxed, with no pain or strain.
entries.definitionCN: 身体放松，没有疼痛或紧张。

normalIntro.en: These hooks run from a task with no obstacle to a body with no pressure, then to a person who imposes no pressure.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子从没有障碍的任务，走到没有压力的身体，再到不把压力加给别人的人。

normal.en: Easy means the path has no obstacle worth mentioning.
normal.cn: easy 意味着这条路上没有值得一提的障碍。

normal.en: A chair in the shade is easy in the older sense: the body has nothing pressing it.
normal.cn: 树荫下的一把椅子就是较早义项的 easy：身体没有被什么压着。

normal.en: An easy teacher is one who does not pass on the strain.
normal.cn: an easy teacher 就是不把紧张传下去的老师。

normal.en: Take it easy is advice about pace, not about difficulty.
normal.cn: take it easy 说的是节奏，不是难度。

normal.en: Easy money is money that arrives without the work that usually stands behind it.
normal.cn: easy money 就是没有平常那层劳动垫底就到手的钱。

abstract.en: Picture a door that opens at a touch, with no hinge sticking and no lock engaged.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇轻轻一碰就开的门，合页不卡，锁也没上。

abstract.en: The same door can be a task, an afternoon, a teacher or a phone app.
abstract.cn: 同一扇门可以是一项任务、一个下午、一位老师或一个手机应用。

abstract.en: Easy means nothing in the situation is fighting back.
abstract.cn: easy 意味着这处境中没有任何东西在跟你较劲。

examples.en: The instructions were easy to follow.
examples.cn: 这些说明很容易照着做。

examples.en: They spent an easy afternoon by the river.
examples.cn: 他们在河边度过了一个轻松的下午。

examples.en: The new app is easy to use on a small phone.
examples.cn: 这个新应用在小屏手机上很好用。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「意兹」——椅子摆进树荫，客人随便坐

root: easy 来自古法语 aisié，即 aisier「使舒适、使便利」的过去分词，词根为 aise「舒适、便利」；其更早来源有拉丁语 adiacens 等解释，尚无定论。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses of easy all describe an absence of resistance: in a task, in the body, in a person's manner, and in a tool or place.
sensesIntro.cn: easy 的四个义项都在描述「没有阻力」：任务里、身体里、一个人的态度里，以及工具或场所里。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a door opens at a touch, with no hinge sticking.
core.cn: 核心意象：一扇门轻轻一碰就开，合页毫不卡顿。

branches.en: THE TASK: little effort or thought is needed.
branches.cn: 任务线：所需的力气或思考很少。

branches.en: THE BODY: comfort, with nothing pressing or worrying.
branches.cn: 身体线：舒适，没有东西压着或让人担心。

branches.en: THE PERSON: a relaxed manner that does not impose strain on others.
branches.cn: 人物线：放松的态度，不把紧张加给别人。

branches.en: THE TOOL: access or use without an obstacle in the way.
branches.cn: 工具线：接触或使用之间没有障碍。

branches.en: THE NO RESISTANCE: in work and in the body, the same absence of friction.
branches.cn: 无阻线：做事与身体里，都是同一种摩擦的缺席。

intro.en: Easy is a French borrowing that English turned into a full family with native suffixes and prefixes.
intro.cn: easy 是法语借词，英语用本族后缀与前缀把它发展成完整词族。

latinIntro.en: A Latin source has been suggested but not proven, so the family is treated as French in origin.
latinIntro.cn: 有人提出拉丁语来源，但未获证明，因此这个词族按法语来源处理。

items.example: The French noun is the base of the family.
items.exampleCN: 这个法语名词是词族的基底。

items.example: The ending appears in the borrowed adjective.
items.exampleCN: 这个词尾出现在借来的形容词中。

definition_zh: 吃；进餐；侵蚀；消耗；困扰
definition_en: to take food into the mouth and swallow it, to have a meal, or to wear away and use up something gradually
core_image: 孩子把盘子清空，只剩一副等着收走的碗筷
scene: 桌上只剩一副碗筷，孩子却已经把盘子清空。He eats slowly, saving the last bite for the end.
sceneCN: 这里 eat 是「吃」（第 1 个义项：把食物送入口中并咽下）；句意为她吃得很慢，把最后一口留到最后。图中可辨识物件：空盘、碗筷、餐桌。

pos.zh: 动词：吃；进餐；侵蚀；消耗；困扰

derivatives.zh: 由本词加施事后缀构成，义为「吃东西的人；食客」
由本词加形容词后缀构成，义为「可食用的」
由过度前缀与本词构成，义为「吃得过多」

senses.title: To take food into the mouth
senses.definition: to put food in the mouth, chew it and swallow it
senses.definitionCN: 把食物放入口中，咀嚼并咽下
senses.example: He eats slowly, saving the last bite for the end.
senses.exampleCN: 他吃得很慢，把最后一口留到最后。
senses.why: Old English etan is one of the oldest verbs in the language, and its meaning has barely moved in a thousand years.
senses.whyCN: 古英语 etan 是这门语言最古老的动词之一，一千年里它的意思几乎没有移动。

senses.title: To have a meal
senses.definition: to have a meal at a particular time or in a particular place
senses.definitionCN: 在某个时间或某个地点吃一顿饭
senses.example: We eat at seven most evenings.
senses.exampleCN: 大多数晚上我们七点吃饭。
senses.why: The same act, seen as a social event on a clock rather than as chewing, becomes the meal sense.
senses.whyCN: 同一个动作，若被看作钟点上的社交事件而不是咀嚼，就成了「用餐」的义项。

senses.title: To wear away by chemical action
senses.titleCN: 侵蚀：因化学作用而磨损
senses.definition: to damage or wear away something gradually, as acid does to metal
senses.definitionCN: 像酸对金属那样，逐渐损坏或磨掉某物
senses.example: Salt water has eaten holes in the old hull.
senses.exampleCN: 海水已经在旧船壳上蚀出了洞。
senses.why: Eating is taking material in; acid and rust take metal in the same way, so the mouth image moved to corrosion.
senses.whyCN: 吃就是把材料纳进来；酸与锈以同样方式把金属纳走，于是「嘴」的意象移到了腐蚀上。

senses.title: To use up gradually
senses.definition: to consume or use up money, time or resources, often in small amounts
senses.definitionCN: 逐渐消耗钱财、时间或资源，常指一点一点地减少
senses.example: Repairs eat into the money we saved for the trip.
senses.exampleCN: 维修费在一点点吃掉我们为旅行存下的钱。
senses.why: Savings are treated as food on a plate: each expense takes a bite until the pile is gone.
senses.whyCN: 存款被当作盘里的食物：每一笔开销咬一口，直到那一堆被吃完。

senses.title: To worry or bother someone
senses.definition: in informal speech, to worry or annoy someone, as in what is eating you
senses.definitionCN: 口语中表示使某人担忧或烦恼，如 what is eating you
senses.example: Something is eating him, but he will not say what.
senses.exampleCN: 有件事在折磨他，但他不肯说是什么。
senses.why: A worry is imagined as something gnawing inside, invisible but steadily consuming the person.
senses.whyCN: 忧虑被想象成在体内啃咬的东西，看不见，却在持续消耗这个人。

intro.en: Eat is a native Germanic verb with an unusually stable history and a surprisingly old root.
intro.cn: eat 是日耳曼语本族动词，历史异常稳定，其词根也异常古老。

items.en: A root generally reconstructed as 'to eat' underlies the verb and is widely represented across the family, though the exact form is uncertain.
items.cn: 一般认为动词来自一个重构为「吃」的词根，这个词根在语系内广泛留存，但其确切形态不确定。

items.en: The Germanic verb meaning to eat is reconstructed and survives in English, Dutch and German forms.
items.cn: 表示「吃」的日耳曼语动词可被重构，并在英语、荷兰语与德语形式中留存。

items.en: Etan was already the ordinary verb for eating, with the same irregular past forms.
items.cn: etan 已是「吃」的常用动词，并已具有同样的不规则过去式。

items.en: The verb kept its shape while gaining figurative uses such as corrode and consume.
items.cn: 这个动词保持形态，同时获得「腐蚀」与「消耗」等比喻用法。

items.en: Everyday phrases such as eat out and eat into extended the verb far beyond the kitchen.
items.cn: eat out、eat into 等日常短语把这个动词远远扩展到厨房之外。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers short verbs and nouns that differ by one letter; the near-meaning group gathers verbs for consuming food.
note.cn: 形近组收只差一个字母的短动词与名词；近义组收表示「进食」的动词。

entries.definition: The direction of sunrise, with no link to food.
entries.definitionCN: 日出的方向，与食物无关。

entries.definition: The organ of hearing, or the head of a grain plant.
entries.definitionCN: 听觉器官，或谷物的穗头。

entries.definition: A person or animal that eats in a stated way.
entries.definitionCN: 以某种方式进食的人或动物。

entries.definition: To eat, drink or use something up, often in a formal register.
entries.definitionCN: 吃、喝或用尽某物，语体常较正式。

entries.definition: To eat something quickly and greedily.
entries.definitionCN: 贪婪而迅速地吃光。

normalIntro.en: These hooks keep the mouth sense and then follow the same image into acid, savings and worry.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子先守住「嘴」的义项，再让同一意象走进酸、存款与忧虑。

normal.en: Eat is the oldest kind of taking in: food goes inside and stays.
normal.cn: eat 是最古老的一种「纳入」：食物进去，并留下来。

normal.en: At seven every evening the same verb becomes a meal on a clock.
normal.cn: 每天晚上七点，同一个动词变成钟点上的一顿饭。

normal.en: Acid eats metal because it takes material in the same way a mouth does.
normal.cn: 酸能吃金属，因为它像嘴一样把材料纳走。

normal.en: A repair bill takes a bite out of savings.
normal.cn: 一张维修账单会在存款上咬一口。

normal.en: A worry eats at a person from the inside, where no one can see it.
normal.cn: 忧虑从里面啃一个人，那里没人看得见。

abstract.en: Picture a mouth, then picture the same gap in a wall, in a budget, and in a person's peace of mind.
abstract.cn: 想象一张嘴，再想象墙上、预算里、以及一个人心里的同一个缺口。

abstract.en: The same taking-in can be food, metal, money or calm.
abstract.cn: 同一种「纳入」可以是食物、金属、金钱或安宁。

abstract.en: Eat means something is being taken away and made part of the taker.
abstract.cn: eat 意味着某物被拿走，并成为取走者的一部分。

examples.en: He eats slowly, saving the last bite for the end.
examples.cn: 他吃得很慢，把最后一口留到最后。

examples.en: We eat at seven most evenings.
examples.cn: 大多数晚上我们七点吃饭。

examples.en: Salt water has eaten holes in the old hull.
examples.cn: 海水已经在旧船壳上蚀出了洞。

root: 古英语 etan「吃」来自日耳曼语，一般可追溯到重构为「吃」的印欧词根；该词根在语系内广泛留存，更早形态不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Five senses of eat all describe taking something in: food, a meal, metal, savings, or a person's peace of mind.
sensesIntro.cn: eat 的五个义项都在描述「把某物纳进来」：食物、一顿饭、金属、存款，或一个人的安宁。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a mouth, and then the same gap opened in a wall, a budget and a mind.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张嘴，以及墙上、预算里和心里被打开的同一个缺口。

branches.en: THE FOOD: the literal act of chewing and swallowing.
branches.cn: 食物线：咀嚼与咽下的字面动作。

branches.en: THE MEAL: the same act placed on a clock and shared with others.
branches.cn: 用餐线：同一动作被放到钟点上，并与他人共享。

branches.en: THE CORROSION: acid takes material in as a mouth takes food.
branches.cn: 腐蚀线：酸像嘴取食物一样取走材料。

branches.en: THE BUDGET: money is consumed bite by bite.
branches.cn: 预算线：钱被一口一口地吃掉。

branches.en: THE WORRY: something invisible gnaws at the person from within.
branches.cn: 忧虑线：某种看不见的东西从内部啃咬这个人。

intro.en: Eat is a native strong verb; English adds agent and adjective suffixes and a few prefixes.
intro.cn: eat 是本族强变化动词，英语给它加施事后缀、形容词后缀与少量前缀。

latinIntro.en: No Latin element is involved in eat itself; the learned synonyms come from Latin later.
latinIntro.cn: eat 本身不含拉丁语成分，书面同义词是后来从拉丁语借入的。

items.example: The Old English verb is the direct source.
items.exampleCN: 这个古英语动词是直接来源。

definition_zh: 回声；回响；附和；共鸣；重复
definition_en: a sound reflected back to the listener, a repeated or imitated response, or a trace reminding one of something past
core_image: 山谷里喊一声，声音从对面岩壁折回来
scene: 山谷里喊一声，声音从对面岩壁折回来。Her shout came back as an echo from the cliff.
sceneCN: 这里 echo 是「回声」（第 1 个义项：被反射回来的声音）；句意为她的喊声从峭壁那边折回来，成了回声。图中可辨识物件：山谷、岩壁、声音的弧线。

pos.zh: 名词：回声；回响；附和；共鸣
动词：发出回声；重复；附和

collocations.zh: 回音室；只重复同类观点的圈子

derivatives.zh: 由本词加形容词后缀构成，义为「回声的；拟声的」
由本词加形容词后缀构成，义为「有回音的」
由本词加否定后缀构成，义为「没有回声的」

senses.title: A reflected sound
senses.definition: a sound that comes back to the listener after bouncing off a surface
senses.definitionCN: 碰到表面后反弹、回到听者耳中的声音
senses.example: Her shout came back as an echo from the cliff.
senses.exampleCN: 她的喊声从峭壁那边折回来，成了回声。
senses.why: The Greek word was first a mythic name, the nymph Echo, and then the sound that repeats a voice.
senses.whyCN: 这个希腊词最初是一个神话中的仙女之名（Echo），随后才指重复人声的那种声音。

senses.title: A repeated or imitated response
senses.titleCN: 附和：重复他人的话或态度
senses.definition: an answer or opinion that repeats what someone else has said, often without independent thought
senses.definitionCN: 重复他人所说或所持态度的回应或意见，常缺乏独立判断
senses.example: The committee's report was an echo of the minister's speech.
senses.exampleCN: 委员会的报道不过是部长讲话的附和。
senses.why: A reflected sound carries no new content, so a repeated opinion is an echo rather than a voice of its own.
senses.whyCN: 反射的声音不带来新内容，所以重复的意见只是回声，而不是自己的声音。

senses.title: A trace or reminder of the past
senses.definition: a faint sign or reminder of something that happened earlier
senses.definitionCN: 较早发生之事留下的微弱迹象或提醒
senses.example: The old customs are an echo of a farming village long gone.
senses.exampleCN: 这些旧习俗是早已消失的农耕村落留下的回响。
senses.why: Something that comes back faintly from far away is like a sound returning late from a wall.
senses.whyCN: 从很远处微弱地返回的东西，就像从墙上迟归的声音。

senses.title: To repeat or reflect sound
senses.definition: to send back a sound, or to repeat words or ideas, often in agreement
senses.definitionCN: 把声音送回，或重复话语与想法，常带赞同意味
senses.example: The valley echoed every word we called.
senses.exampleCN: 山谷把我们喊出的每个词都送了回来。
senses.why: The verb turns the noun into an act: the surface or the speaker sends the same thing back.
senses.whyCN: 动词把名词变成动作：表面或说话者把同样的东西送回来。

intro.en: Echo came from Greek through Latin, and its first life was in myth rather than in physics.
intro.cn: echo 经由拉丁语来自希腊语，它最初的身份是神话，而不是物理现象。

items.en: Ēkhō was the name of a nymph in Greek myth who could only repeat the words of others; the common noun for the reflected sound followed.
items.cn: ēkhō 是希腊神话中只能重复他人话语的仙女之名；表示反射声音的普通名词随后出现。

items.en: Latin borrowed the Greek word and used it both for the myth and for the physical sound.
items.cn: 拉丁语借入这个希腊词，既用于神话，也用于物理上的声音。

items.en: English took the word from Latin and French and applied it to any sound sent back by a surface.
items.cn: 英语从拉丁语与法语引入这个词，用来指任何被表面送回的声音。

items.en: The figurative senses of imitation and remembrance appeared, especially in literary writing.
items.cn: 模仿与追忆的比喻义出现，尤见于文学写作。

items.en: Technology gave echo new compounds such as echo chamber and echolocation.
items.cn: 技术为 echo 带来 echo chamber 与 echolocation 等新复合词。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words beginning with the same sound; the near-meaning group gathers words for reflected sound and repetition.
note.cn: 形近组收开头读音相同的词；近义组收表示「反射声」与「重复」的词。

entries.definition: An adjective relating to money, trade and the economy.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为与金钱、贸易和经济有关的。

entries.definition: An adjective meaning echo-like or imitative in sound.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「回声般的」或「拟声的」。

entries.definition: An adjective meaning without any echo.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「没有回声的」。

entries.definition: A repeated or lingering sound after it bounces around a space.
entries.definitionCN: 声音在空间中反复反弹后持续回响的现象。

entries.definition: The act of saying or doing the same thing again.
entries.definitionCN: 把同样的话或事再说、再做一次的行为。

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a shout against a cliff and end with an opinion that only repeats another opinion.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子从对着峭壁的一声喊开始，到只会重复别人意见的观点结束。

normal.en: Echo is a sound that comes home late, carrying nothing new.
normal.cn: echo 是一个迟归的声音，什么新东西也没带回来。

normal.en: A wall sends your voice back; a follower sends your opinion back.
normal.cn: 墙把你的声音送回；附和者把你的观点送回。

normal.en: An echo of the past is history returning faintly from a distance.
normal.cn: an echo of the past 就是从远处微弱返回的历史。

normal.en: Echo as a verb: the valley does the repeating, not you.
normal.cn: echo 作动词时，重复的是山谷，不是你。

normal.en: An echo chamber is a room, or a circle, where the same sound never leaves.
normal.cn: echo chamber 是一间屋子，或一个圈子，同样的声音始终出不去。

abstract.en: Picture a shout striking a stone face and turning back along its own path.
abstract.cn: 想象一声喊撞上石壁，沿着自己的路径折返。

abstract.en: The same returning path can be sound, agreement, memory or a rumour.
abstract.cn: 同一条折返路径可以是声音、赞同、记忆或一则传言。

abstract.en: Echo means nothing original arrives, only a copy of what was sent.
abstract.cn: echo 意味着到达的没有原物，只有被送出之物的副本。

examples.en: Her shout came back as an echo from the cliff.
examples.cn: 她的喊声从峭壁那边折回来，成了回声。

examples.en: The committee's report was an echo of the minister's speech.
examples.cn: 委员会的报道不过是部长讲话的附和。

examples.en: The valley echoed every word we called.
examples.cn: 山谷把我们喊出的每个词都送了回来。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「埃科」——对着岩壁一喊，声音自己折回来

root: 希腊语 ēkhō 原为神话中只能重复他人话语的仙女之名，后指反射回来的声音；经拉丁语 echo 进入英语。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses of echo all involve something sent back: a sound, an opinion, a trace of the past, and the act of repeating.
sensesIntro.cn: echo 的四个义项都涉及「被送回的东西」：声音、意见、往昔的痕迹，以及重复这个动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a shout hits a stone face and turns back along its own path.
core.cn: 核心意象：一声喊撞上石壁，沿自己的路径折返。

branches.en: THE PHYSICS: a sound bounced back from a surface.
branches.cn: 物理线：从表面反弹回来的声音。

branches.en: THE OPINION: a response that only repeats what another said.
branches.cn: 意见线：只重复他人所说内容的回应。

branches.en: THE MEMORY: history returning faintly from a distance.
branches.cn: 记忆线：从远处微弱返回的历史。

branches.en: THE ACT: the verb of sending sound or words back.
branches.cn: 动作线：把声音或话语送回的动词。

branches.en: THE RETURN: what comes back is real but diminished, whether sound or the past.
branches.cn: 折返线：回来的东西真实但已减弱，无论声音还是往昔。

intro.en: Echo is a Greek borrowing, so English affixes are added only at the edges.
intro.cn: echo 是希腊语借词，英语只在边缘加后缀。

latinIntro.en: Latin echo is the recorded intermediate form between the Greek noun and English.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 echo 是希腊名词与英语之间有记录的中介形式。

items.example: The Greek word supplied both myth and sound.
items.exampleCN: 这个希腊词同时提供神话与声音。

items.example: Latin carried the word into English.
items.exampleCN: 拉丁语把这个词带入英语。

definition_zh: 经济的；经济学的；有经济效益的
definition_en: relating to the production, trade and use of money and goods, to economics as a subject, or to something profitable

scene: 报纸头版全是物价、就业与利率的曲线。The country entered a long period of economic growth.
sceneCN: 这里 economic 是「经济的」（第 1 个义项：与生产、贸易及金钱有关）；句意为这个国家进入了长期的经济增长期。图中可辨识物件：报纸头版、曲线图、物价数字。

pos.zh: 形容词：经济的；经济学的；有经济效益的

senses.title: Relating to the economy
senses.titleCN: 经济的：与生产、贸易和金钱有关
senses.definition: relating to the production, distribution and use of goods, money and services in a country or region
senses.definitionCN: 与国家或地区的商品生产、分配、货币及服务有关的
senses.example: The country entered a long period of economic growth.
senses.exampleCN: 这个国家进入了长期的经济增长期。
senses.why: Greek oikonomia meant managing a household, and the adjective still describes the large-scale version of that management.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 oikonomia 意为「管理家务」，这个形容词描述的仍是这种管理在庞大尺度上的版本。

senses.title: Relating to economics
senses.titleCN: 经济学的：属于这门学科
senses.definition: belonging to economics as an academic subject or method of analysis
senses.definitionCN: 属于作为学科或分析方法的「经济学」
senses.example: The paper uses an economic model to explain migration.
senses.exampleCN: 这篇论文用一个经济学模型解释人口迁移。
senses.why: Once a body of theory grew around household management, the adjective also named the theory rather than the world it studies.
senses.whyCN: 当围绕「家务管理」长出一套理论，这个形容词也用来指理论本身，而不是它所研究的世界。

senses.title: Profitable or viable
senses.titleCN: 有经济效益的：划算、可行
senses.definition: capable of producing enough profit or saving enough money to be worthwhile
senses.definitionCN: 能产生足够利润或省下足够金钱因而值得做的
senses.example: It is not economic to ship the ore by road.
senses.exampleCN: 用公路运矿石并不划算。
senses.why: Management must balance costs and returns, so anything that pays its way can be called economic.
senses.whyCN: 管理必须权衡成本与收益，所以任何能收回成本的东西都可以叫 economic。

intro.en: Economic goes back to a Greek word for running a household, and the modern sense scaled it up to whole nations.
intro.cn: economic 可追到希腊语中「管理家务」的词，现代义把它放大到整个国家。

items.en: Oikos meant house or household, the basic unit of production and consumption.
items.cn: oikos 意为房子、家户，是生产与消费的基本单位。

items.en: Nomos meant law, custom or rule, so oikonomia was the rule of the household.
items.cn: nomos 意为法律、习俗或规则，因此 oikonomia 就是「家户的规则」。

items.en: Oikonomia meant household management and later also the management of public resources.
items.cn: oikonomia 意为家务管理，后来也指公共资源的管理。

items.en: French formed the adjective and English borrowed it in the eighteenth century, when the modern science was taking shape.
items.cn: 法语构成这个形容词，英语在十八世纪借入，正值现代经济学成形之时。

items.en: Economic became the general adjective, while economical specialised in saving money and effort.
items.cn: economic 成为一般形容词，而 economical 专门表示省钱与省力。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the economic family and its common confusions; the near-meaning group gathers adjectives for money and profitability.
note.cn: 形近组收 economic 词族与常见的混淆词；近义组收表示金钱与盈利的形容词。

entries.definition: An adjective meaning thrifty or cheap to run, often confused with economic.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「节约的、使用成本低的」，常与 economic 混淆。

entries.definition: The system of money and trade, or the careful use of resources.
entries.definitionCN: 金钱与贸易体系，或对资源的节省使用。

entries.definition: The academic study of production, trade and money.
entries.definitionCN: 研究生产、贸易与金钱的学科。

entries.definition: Relating to money and its management, especially at a personal or corporate level.
entries.definitionCN: 与金钱及其管理有关，尤指个人或公司层面。

entries.definition: Relating to trade and business, or intended to make a profit.
entries.definitionCN: 与贸易、商业有关，或目的在于盈利的。

normalIntro.en: These hooks move from a household account book to a national budget and then to the test of whether a plan pays.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子从一本家用账走到国家预算，再到一项计划是否回本的检验。

normal.en: Economic begins at a kitchen table: oikos is a house, nomos is a rule.
normal.cn: economic 起于一张厨房桌：oikos 是房子，nomos 是规则。

normal.en: Scale the household up and the same word describes a nation's production.
normal.cn: 把家户放大，同一个词就描述一个国家的生产。

normal.en: Economic can also name the theory: an economic model is not the economy.
normal.cn: economic 也可以指理论：an economic model 不是经济本身。

normal.en: If a plan pays for itself, it is economic; if it merely saves, it is economical.
normal.cn: 一项计划若能自己回本，就是 economic；若只是省，就是 economical。

normal.en: Keep economic and financial apart: one is the system, the other is the money in it.
normal.cn: 把 economic 与 financial 分开：一个是系统，一个是系统中的钱。

abstract.en: Picture a single household ledger opened out until it covers a whole country.
abstract.cn: 想象一本家用账簿被摊开，直到覆盖一整个国家。

abstract.en: The same ledger can show wages, prices, taxes or the cost of a new railway.
abstract.cn: 同一本账簿可以显示工资、物价、税收，或一条新铁路的成本。

abstract.en: Economic means the rules by which a society produces and shares what it has.
abstract.cn: economic 意味着一个社会借以生产与分配其所有之物的规则。

examples.en: The country entered a long period of economic growth.
examples.cn: 这个国家进入了长期的经济增长期。

examples.en: The paper uses an economic model to explain migration.
examples.cn: 这篇论文用一个经济学模型解释人口迁移。

examples.en: It is not economic to ship the ore by road.
examples.cn: 用公路运矿石并不划算。

root: 希腊语 oikonomia「家务管理」由 oikos「家户」与 nomos「规则」构成，其形容词经法语 économique 进入英语；现代义扩展到国家经济与经济学。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses of economic: the real system of production and trade, the academic study of it, and the practical test of whether something pays.
sensesIntro.cn: economic 的三个义项：真实的生产与贸易体系、对它的学术研究，以及某事物是否回本的实用检验。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one household ledger is opened out until it covers a whole country.
core.cn: 核心意象：一本家用账簿被摊开，直到覆盖一整个国家。

branches.en: THE SYSTEM: production, trade and money in a country or region.
branches.cn: 系统线：国家或地区的生产、贸易与金钱。

branches.en: THE SUBJECT: the theory and models used to study that system.
branches.cn: 学科线：研究该系统的理论与模型。

branches.en: THE TEST: whether a plan produces enough return to be worthwhile.
branches.cn: 检验线：一项计划能否产生足够回报而值得做。

branches.en: THE SCALE: the same household idea appears as a nation and as a model of that nation.
branches.cn: 尺度线：同一个「家户」观念，既出现在国家，也出现在国家的模型里。

branches.en: THE ACCOUNT: costs and returns are weighed whether by a state or by a builder.
branches.cn: 账目线：无论国家还是建造者，都要权衡成本与回报。

intro.en: Economic is a Greek-derived adjective; English adds noun, person and negation affixes around its stem.
intro.cn: economic 是源自希腊语的形容词，英语在其词干周围加名词、指人与否定词缀。

latinIntro.en: Greek oikonomia reached English through Latin and French, so the root is Greek while the route is Latin.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊语 oikonomia 经拉丁语与法语进入英语，因此词根是希腊语，路径是拉丁语。

items.example: The root names the unit being managed.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根指被管理的单位。

items.example: The second root names the rule.
The compound is the direct ancestor of economy.
items.exampleCN: 这个复合词是 economy 的直接祖先。

core_image: 厨房的灯泡换成低瓦数，水龙头也装了限流器

senses.title: Careful with money and resources
senses.titleCN: 节约的：不浪费钱财与资源
senses.definition: using money, fuel, time or materials carefully so that nothing is wasted
senses.definitionCN: 谨慎使用金钱、燃料、时间或材料，不让任何东西被浪费
senses.example: The household is economical with water in dry summers.
senses.exampleCN: 干旱的夏天里，这家人很节约用水。
senses.why: The Greek root meant managing a household; the adjective describes a person who manages without waste.
senses.whyCN: 希腊词根意为「管理家户」，这个形容词描述的是不浪费地管理的人。

senses.title: Cheap to buy and run
senses.titleCN: 经济实惠的：购买与使用成本低
senses.definition: designed to need little fuel, money or effort to operate
senses.definitionCN: 设计上只需很少燃料、金钱或精力即可运转
senses.example: This small car is economical to run.
senses.exampleCN: 这辆小车用起来很省钱。
senses.why: A machine that manages its fuel like a careful household manager is economical, even though it never holds a purse.
senses.whyCN: 一台像精打细算的当家人那样管理燃料的机器就是 economical，尽管它从不拿钱包。

senses.title: Brief and not wasteful in expression
senses.titleCN: 简洁的：表达不浪费字句
senses.definition: using only the words or means needed, with nothing extra
senses.definitionCN: 只使用所需的字句或手段，没有多余部分
senses.example: Her economical prose leaves no sentence to cut.
senses.exampleCN: 她的文风简洁，没有一句是可以删的。
senses.why: Words are a resource too, so the same habit of not wasting applies to language.
senses.whyCN: 字句也是一种资源，于是「不浪费」的同一习惯也用到了语言上。

intro.en: Economical shares the Greek root of economic but took a different suffix and a narrower everyday sense.
intro.cn: economical 与 economic 共享希腊词根，但取了不同后缀，日常含义也更窄。

items.en: Oikonomikos meant skilled in household management, which is the sense the English adjective first carried.
items.cn: oikonomikos 意为擅长家务管理，这正是英语形容词最早承载的意思。

items.en: The Latin adjective passed into learned European use and later into English.
items.cn: 这个拉丁形容词进入欧洲的书面语，后来进入英语。

items.en: Economical is recorded in the sixteenth century with the sense of managing a household well.
items.cn: economical 在十六世纪有记录，义为善于管理家户。

items.en: As machines spread, the adjective came to describe engines and lamps that used little fuel.
items.cn: 随着机器普及，这个形容词开始描述耗油少的发动机与省电的灯。

items.en: Economic took the large public sense, leaving economical with personal thrift, low running costs and spare prose.
items.cn: economic 拿走了大型公共义，把个人节俭、低运行成本与简洁文风留给 economical。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the pair most often confused; the near-meaning group gathers adjectives for thrift and low cost.
note.cn: 形近组收最常被混淆的那一对词；近义组收表示节俭与低成本的形容词。

entries.definition: An adjective for the economy or economics, not for personal thrift.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，指经济或经济学，而非个人节俭。

entries.definition: The system of money and trade, or careful use of resources.
entries.definitionCN: 金钱与贸易体系，或对资源的谨慎使用。

entries.definition: The adverb meaning thriftily, or with respect to the economy.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「节约地」，或「在经济方面」。

entries.definition: Careful with money, saving rather than spending.
entries.definitionCN: 用钱谨慎，宁可存下也不乱花。

entries.definition: Simple and cheap, avoiding unnecessary expense.
entries.definitionCN: 简朴而便宜，避免不必要的开支。

normalIntro.en: These hooks follow a careful household manager into a low-fuel engine and then into a short sentence.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子跟着一位精打细算的当家人，走进低耗油的发动机，再走进一个短句。

normal.en: Economical is the household word, economic is the national one.
normal.cn: economical 是家户的词，economic 是国家的词。

normal.en: A low-watt bulb and a flow limiter are economical made visible.
normal.cn: 低瓦数灯泡与限流器，就是看得见的 economical。

normal.en: A car can be economical because it manages fuel like a careful manager.
normal.cn: 一辆车可以很 economical，因为它像谨慎的管家那样管理燃料。

normal.en: Economical prose wastes neither words nor the reader's time.
normal.cn: 简洁的文风既不浪费字，也不浪费读者的时间。

normal.en: Economical with the truth is a polite way of saying not fully honest.
normal.cn: economical with the truth 是「不完全说实话」的委婉说法。

abstract.en: Picture a tap fitted with a small brass limiter, letting through only what is needed.
abstract.cn: 想象一只水龙头装了小小的黄铜限流器，只放行必需的量。

abstract.en: The same limiting can apply to fuel, money, words or a machine's appetite.
abstract.cn: 同一种「限量」可以用在燃料、金钱、字句，或一台机器的胃口上。

abstract.en: Economical means the flow is cut to exactly what the job requires.
abstract.cn: economical 意味着流量被削减到正好够用。

examples.en: This small car is economical to run.
examples.cn: 这辆小车用起来很省钱。

examples.en: The household is economical with water in dry summers.
examples.cn: 干旱的夏天里，这家人很节约用水。

examples.en: Her economical prose leaves no sentence to cut.
examples.cn: 她的文风简洁，没有一句是可以删的。

root: 希腊语 oikonomikos「擅长家务管理」经拉丁语 oeconomicus 进入英语；与 economic 同源，但 economical 专指节约、低耗与简洁。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses of economical all cut waste: money and resources, fuel and running costs, and words.
sensesIntro.cn: economical 的三个义项都在削减浪费：钱财与资源、燃料与运行成本，以及字句。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a tap is fitted with a small brass limiter that passes only what is needed.
core.cn: 核心意象：水龙头装了小小的黄铜限流器，只放行必需的量。

branches.en: THE HOUSEHOLD: money and resources used without waste.
branches.cn: 家户线：不浪费地使用钱财与资源。

branches.en: THE MACHINE: low fuel and low cost in operation.
branches.cn: 机器线：运行时燃料少、成本低。

branches.en: THE PROSE: words cut to exactly what the meaning needs.
branches.cn: 文句线：字句被削减到正好承载意思。

branches.en: THE BUDGET: a person and a machine both spend little to do the job.
branches.cn: 预算线：人与机器都花很少就完成了任务。

branches.en: THE ECONOMY OF MEANS: thrift applied to money and to language alike.
branches.cn: 手段经济线：节俭同样用于金钱与语言。

intro.cn: economical 是源自希腊语的形容词，经拉丁语与法语过渡，再加普通英语后缀。

latinIntro.en: Latin oeconomicus is recorded as the intermediate adjective between Greek and English.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 oeconomicus 是希腊语与英语之间有记录的中间形容词。
